Daily Devotional

March 19

3 According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue: (2 Peter 1:3 KJV)

Peter is saying that we already have all things that pertain to life and godliness. Notice it is through the knowledge of the Word. Jesus has already given us all we need to live the victorious Christian life now. We don’t need God to give us more, but we need to renew our minds by studying the Word of God (Romans 12:2), and finding out what we already have, and how to use it. We already have Faith (Galatians 5:22-23), Healing (1 Peter 2:24), Prosperity (2 Corinthians 8:9), and even rising from the dead power (Ephesians 1:19-20).

Our problem is learning just what all Jesus did for us by His crucifixion. We have all this power deposited on the inside of every born again believer, who is baptized in the Holy Ghost, and just need to learn what we already have (Philippians 6). Most Christians spend their life begging God to give them what they already have been given, and just don’t know that they have it. We have to renew our minds and find out how to move what we already have into the physical realm from the spiritual one. Thank you Lord for giving us the Glory of God to live in us believers (Romans 8:18).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
